text: They're opening the lodge, Majesty. Here they come.

voice.description: An old army general in his sixties: a deep, weathered, gravelly bass voice, gruff and dry, loyal and sceptical, a veteran who has seen too much, speaks in short measured sentences with quiet authority and a hint of dry humour. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
